dct_title_s: Godfrey Bridal Veil Mississippi Street opening
dct_alternative_sm: Godfrey Bridal Veil Mississippi Street opening
dct_description_sm: Map showing "Godfrey's Bridal Veil Block" in the Prospect Park neighborhood of Minneapolis, Minnesota. A vacated portion of Hamline Avenue near Mississippi Street at the Franklin Avenue Bridge is demarcated. Shows land areas in square feet. Land owned by William J. Godfrey is labeled.; Oriented with north toward the upper left.; Depth shown by isolines.; Title from map sheet.
